description: This Java class defines a custom FreeMarker transform named LimitedSubContentCacheTransform, which is used within the OFBiz framework to process content associations and generate related URL links for content entities. It manages content retrieval, filtering, and context management for template rendering.

classes.name: LimitedSubContentCacheTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform class implementing TemplateTransformModel for processing content associations and generating URL links within OFBiz.
